note: Lolo National Forest (Plains/Thompson Falls Ranger District) primitive campground, an open, sunny site in the canyon bottom on the Thompson River, ~5 mi north of MT-200 on Thompson River Road. Sites with picnic tables/fire rings; small RVs only - max ~24 ft and several sites cap at 20 ft, so only the largest site fits a 23-ft rig. --Claude
